cases.name: demo: kinetic energy, no formula line and no unit

question.text: A body of mass 2 kg moves at 3 m/s. Find its kinetic energy.

cases.scheme: 1. States the given values with symbols (2 marks). 2. Writes the formula E = 1/2 m v^2 before using it (2 marks). 3. Substitutes the values correctly (2 marks). 4. Calculates correctly: E = 9 (2 marks). 5. Gives the final answer with the unit, 9 J (2 marks).

cases.name: max height, full marks

question.text: A ball is thrown vertically upward at 20 m/s. Find the maximum height reached. Take g = 10 m/s^2.

cases.scheme: 1 mark: correct equation v^2 = u^2 - 2gh with v = 0 at the top. 1 mark: correct substitution. 2 marks: correct calculation h = 20. 1 mark: unit (m).

cases.name: net force, units missing

question.text: A 5 kg block accelerates from rest to 10 m/s in 4 s. Find the net force on it.

cases.scheme: 1 mark: a = (v - u)/t stated. 1 mark: a = 2.5 m/s^2. 1 mark: F = ma stated. 1 mark: F = 12.5. 1 mark: units given for the final answer (N).

cases.name: lift normal force, wrong sign

question.text: A 60 kg person stands in a lift accelerating upward at 2 m/s^2. Find the normal force on the person. Take g = 10 m/s^2.

cases.scheme: 1 mark: forces identified (N upward, mg downward). 2 marks: correct equation N - mg = ma. 1 mark: correct substitution N = 60(10 + 2). 1 mark: N = 720. 1 mark: unit (N). No marks are carried forward from an incorrect equation, except the unit mark.

cases.name: free fall time, skipped step

question.text: An object falls from rest through 45 m. Find the time taken. Take g = 10 m/s^2.

cases.scheme: 1 mark: s = ut + (1/2)gt^2 stated. 1 mark: correct substitution 45 = 5t^2. 1 mark: t^2 = 9 shown explicitly. 1 mark: t = 3. 1 mark: unit (s).

cases.name: work at an angle, formula missing cos

question.text: A force of 10 N moves a body 5 m, at 60 degrees to the displacement. Find the work done. Take cos 60 = 0.5.

cases.scheme: 2 marks: correct formula W = F s cos(theta). 1 mark: correct substitution. 1 mark: cos 60 = 0.5 used. 1 mark: W = 25. 1 mark: unit (J). No marks are carried forward from an incorrect formula, except the unit mark.
